cli.help.config_mode: Configuration mode: --config, TASKPUSH_CONFIG_JSON or ./taskpush.json supplies the channels
cli.help.inline_mode: Inline mode: --webhook, --type, --set or --payload builds one channel and ignores TASKPUSH_CONFIG_JSON
cli.help.notes: Flags may appear before or after the command; everything after -- is a positional argument; --help after a command shows that command's help
cli.help.command.send: Send one notification to the selected channels
cli.help.command.finish: Send one notification timed from the start time and remove the state file
cli.help.command.start: Write the current time as the start of a timed run
cli.help.command.check: Validate the channel configuration and content without sending
cli.help.command.list: List the channels of the configuration
cli.help.command.types: List the channel types or the fields of one type
cli.help.command.help: Print help, optionally for one command
cli.help.flag.title: --title TEXT
cli.error.flag_not_for_command: flag {{.Flag}} is not valid for command {{.Command}} (available: {{.Available}})
cli.error.duplicate_flag: flag {{.Flag}} is given more than once
cli.error.missing_command: a command is required when command flags are given
cli.error.inline_config_conflict: inline mode cannot be combined with --config
cli.error.inline_channel_conflict: inline mode cannot be combined with --channel
cli.error.inline_all_conflict: inline mode cannot be combined with --all
cli.error.webhook_url_conflict: --webhook already sets url, so url must not be set again
cli.error.stdin_conflict: only one of {{.Flags}} may read stdin
cli.error.invalid_parallel: --parallel must be an integer between 1 and 8, got {{.Value}}
cli.error.invalid_bool: flag {{.Flag}} accepts true, false, 1 or 0, got {{.Value}}
cli.error.value_dash: the value {{.Value}} of {{.Flag}} starts with --, so write it as {{.Flag}}=VALUE
cli.info.start_dry_run: would write the start time {{.Time}} to {{.Path}}
cli.warn.finish_rerun: a rerun sends to the channels that already succeeded again
cli.info.init_exists: {{.Path}} already exists, pass --force to overwrite it
cli.desc.command.finish: send the timed result and clean up the state
cli.desc.command.start: record the start of a timed run
cli.desc.command.types: list channel types or their fields
cli.desc.flag.help: show help, and after a command show that command's help
cli.desc.flag.lang: output language: en or zh-CN, default en
cli.desc.flag.title: title template, mutually exclusive with --title-file
cli.desc.flag.title-file: read the title from a file, - reads stdin
cli.desc.flag.body-file: read the body from a file, - reads stdin
cli.desc.flag.var-file: read variables from a JSON object file, - reads stdin
cli.desc.flag.dry-run: render and validate fully without sending
cli.desc.flag.state-file: state file path, overriding the path derived from --config
cli.desc.flag.keep-state: keep the state file after a successful send
cli.desc.flag.all: include disabled channels and their deferred errors
cli.desc.flag.webhook: build an inline webhook channel from a URL
cli.desc.flag.type: build one inline channel of this type
